//overrides: Pins patched versions of vulnerable transitive build-tooling deps (expo, jest, tailwind); bun has no nested overrides, so each entry is one version for every consumer. js-yaml stays on 4.x (4.3.2) and decode-uri-component is forced to 0.5.0 (GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr, reachable through expo-router); @xmldom/xmldom is not overridden because 0.9.12 breaks @expo/plist. source-map-js (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q) and postcss-selector-parser (GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf; postcss-nested under tailwind 3 asks for ^6, forced to 7.x) are overridden past their advisories; the web export CSS and JS were byte-identical before and after. Revisit when an SDK bump lets these resolve on their own.
//audit-known: node-forge (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv, <=1.4.0) and zod 3 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, <4.6.6) are the `bun audit` findings no override can clear: node-forge has no patched release, and the zod fix exists only in 4.x while @expo/cli (its only consumer here) requires zod ^3.25.76. Both are build-time only (the Expo CLI, its config validation and code-signing certificate tooling), so the `Audit (JS)` job stays red on purpose; add an override once a patched release ships or the Expo CLI moves to zod 4.
